question: 单项选择：Could you tell me where _____? A. is the bank  B. the bank is  C. the bank was  D. was the bank
answer: 答案：B. the bank is。解析：宾语从句用陈述语序：主语+谓语+其他。the bank is是正确语序。

question: 单项选择：I don't know _____ he is. A. where  B. where is  C. where does  D. where do
answer: 答案：A. where。解析：where引导宾语从句用陈述语序。he is是正确的。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：Do you know what time ______ (start)?
answer: 答案：it starts。解析：what time引导宾语从句用陈述语序。主语it用starts。

question: 单项选择：I wonder _____ the movie starts. A. when  B. when does  C. what time  D. A and C
answer: 答案：D. A and C。解析：when/what time引导宾语从句用陈述语序。

question: 翻译句子：你能告诉我他住哪里吗？
answer: 答案：Could you tell me where he lives? 解析：where引导宾语从句用陈述语序。he lives是正确语序。

question: 单项选择：He asked me _____ to the party. A. if I would go  B. if will I go  C. if I go  D. if do I go
answer: 答案：A. if I would go。解析：if引导宾语从句用陈述语序。主句asked是过去时，从句要用相应的过去时态，所以用would go而不是will go。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I don't know what ______ (be) her name.
answer: 答案：is。解析：what引导宾语从句用陈述语序。主语her name用is。

question: 单项选择：Could you tell me _____ the post office is? A. where  B. where is  C. how  D. when
answer: 答案：A. where。解析：where引导宾语从句用陈述语序。the post office is是正确语序。

question: 翻译句子：她问我是哪本书。
answer: 答案：She asked me which book it was. 解析：which引导宾语从句用陈述语序。主句asked是过去时，从句用过去时was。

question: 单项选择：I don't know _____ or not. A. if he will come  B. whether he will come  C. whether will he come  D. A and B
answer: 答案：D. A and B。解析：if/whether引导宾语从句用陈述语序。
